text:
zoe: PSA: Louie staged a full laptop lounge takeover during standup. he is now an input blocker. photo attached
photo-bot: uploaded image: louie_laptop_lounge.jpg (1200x800)
jack: he has claimed both screens and my calendar access. rude but effective. :joy:
ines: quick question: does 'pet-on-keyboard' count as a new feature request? asking for... everyone. :sweat_smile:
maya: proposal: designate a "warm keyboard" policy. Louie gets first dibs on warm laptops. 
jack: love it. also, who taught him to press "leave meeting" with precision? :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
ines: suspect it's accidental, but results are suspiciously timely. 
ops-bot: note: office-animals policy reminder posted to #people-ops — please register therapy animals before bringing to shared desks. tagging @people-ops
zoe: noted. Louie will accept registration and an embroidered collar in exchange for fewer meeting interruptions. :paw_prints:
jack: poll: should we make "Louie cameo" a recurring segment in all-hands? yes/no
ines: yes. moral boost specialists vote yes. :raised_hands:
maya: i will bring treats. he prefers the crunchy ones, and occasional capricious pouncing on power cords. 
photo-bot: reaction :heart_eyes: added by jack
zoe: thanks team. Louie sends a slow blink and a soft tap to the spacebar as proof of performance. :cat2:
